original.target_description: Experiment 3, six within-participant tasks crossing A+ frequency (2 vs. 6) and B− frequency (2 vs. 4 vs. 6); separate cause-rating ANOVAs and six A-versus-B comparisons. Supplied description instead says predicted values for A and B under high versus low B prevalence; no unique target test is identified.

notes: BLIND completion; only n_o, es_value_o, pval_value_o assigned. Experiment 3 is located at printed pp. 209–211 (PDF pp. 6–8), including supplied p. 7. Description/locator conflict: Experiment 3 changes B− frequency, not low/high B prevalence, and distinguishes deterministic model predictions from observed causal judgments. No statistic selected by numeric matching or input order. Candidate sample: Method explicitly gives 37 participants; repeated-measures results use F(1,36) and F(2,72), but N is retained only as a candidate pending target correspondence, not derived from df. No explicit critical-test final sample or exclusion accounting resolves the target. Printed p. 211 discusses removing 4 participants as a separate descriptive sensitivity observation; do not substitute 33 for the primary sample. No arithmetic N sum performed. Candidate tests: p. 210 Cause A A+ main effect F(1,36)=26.88, p<.001; Cause B A+ main effect F(1,36)=22.88, p<.001; Cause B B− main effect F(2,72)=9.81, p<.001; Cause B interaction F(2,72)=3.16, p<.05. All metrics are printed F statistics, without conversion. Prediction 2 A-versus-B tests on p. 211: A+=2/B−=2 F(1,36)=24.57 p<.001; A+=2/B−=4 F(1,36)=23.99 p<.001; A+=2/B−=6 F(1,36)=6.55 p<.05; A+=6/B−=2 F(1,36)=9.33 p<.001; A+=6/B−=4 F(1,36)=0.59 with no numeric p; A+=6/B−=6 F(1,36)=0.13 with no numeric p. Table 3 model prediction rows are not inferential tests. Low/high B-prevalence manipulations occur in Experiments 1 and 2, which cannot silently replace assigned Study 3. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders only. Rendered PDF pp. 6–8 inspected for layout; canonical text used for evidence.
